text: わざを　だす　までに　こうげきを　うけると　ひるんで　しまう。

structure.jp: わざを　だす　までに
こうげきを　うけると

patterns.name: 〜までに
patterns.explanation: までに after a verb means 'at some point before that happens'. わざを　だす　までに = 'before it gets the move out'.

patterns.name: 〜と (if/when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever that happens, this follows'. こうげきを　うけると = 'if it takes an attack'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happens completely, often as something unwanted. ひるんで　しまう = 'it ends up flinching'.
